summary: The Windows clean-install relay run produced release-relevant evidence. Positive and negative trigger boundaries held, vendor/source-governance routing passed, and the multi-turn workflow produced a PRD Draft without finalizing or entering implementation. The run also exposed process and documentation improvements.

substantive_findings.finding: N3 skill-maintenance request avoided product discovery but mutated the installed skill, contaminating the clean test environment.
substantive_findings.product_impact: Future clean-install tests can become invalid if maintenance negative controls are allowed to edit the installed runtime.
substantive_findings.actionability: Update the Windows test packet to prohibit file edits during negative-control prompts or run maintenance mutation tests in a disposable copy.

substantive_findings.finding: Windows response identified real documentation/protocol improvements: version-aware promoted run paths and Windows packaging instructions.
substantive_findings.product_impact: These improvements reduce versioning mistakes and make Windows validation more reproducible.
substantive_findings.actionability: Patch repository docs and pressure-test protocol before the next validation cycle.

substantive_findings.finding: P3 exposed superpowers:brainstorming in the user-facing output.
substantive_findings.product_impact: This can make the platform-agnostic skill appear dependent on host-specific helper skills.
substantive_findings.actionability: Clarify optional host tooling language in SKILL.md or future eval criteria.

substantive_findings.finding: E2E turns 3-4 showed mild advisor overreach by strongly recommending a target segment and MVP angle.
substantive_findings.product_impact: The workflow may prematurely narrow strategy before explicit user acceptance.
substantive_findings.actionability: Add a rubric item or guidance requiring strong recommendations to remain candidate decisions until user-gated acceptance.

required_next_action: Patch repository docs for GitHub subdirectory install path.
Patch pressure-test protocol to use current/<tested-version>/<run-id>/.
Patch Windows test packet to prevent mutation during clean-install negative controls.
Rerun affected maintenance/install documentation checks after patch.
Defer install-candidate claim until patched run and final review pass.
rationale: The run found no hard failure in product-discovery behavior and produced concrete improvements that affect future validation reliability. It should be retained as v0.1.6 project evidence, but it should not be used as release-grade proof.
